scripts.build:shared: npm exec --workspace=@mspi/shared-db -- tsc && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/shared-auth -- tsc && echo 'SHARED_BUILD_COMPLETE'
scripts.build:pcount: npm run build:shared && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/pcount-frontend -- tsc -b && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/pcount-frontend -- vite build && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/pcount-backend -- tsc && mkdir -p apps/pcount/backend/dist && rm -rf apps/pcount/backend/dist/public && mkdir -p apps/pcount/backend/dist/public && cp -r apps/pcount/frontend/dist/. apps/pcount/backend/dist/public/ && echo 'PCOUNT_BUILD_COMPLETE' && ls -la apps/pcount/backend/dist && ls -la apps/pcount/backend/dist/public
scripts.build:rfpu: npm run build:shared && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/rfpu-frontend -- tsc -b && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/rfpu-frontend -- vite build && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/rfpu-backend -- tsc && echo 'RFPU_BUILD_COMPLETE' && ls -la apps/rfpu/backend/dist && ls -la apps/rfpu/frontend/dist
scripts.build:launcher: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @mspi/launcher-backend && echo 'LAUNCHER_BUILD_COMPLETE' && ls -la apps/launcher/backend/dist && ls -la apps/launcher/backend/dist/public
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:pcount && npm run build:rfpu && npm run build:launcher
